description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\ClientSideMonitoring namespace. It provides methods to generate configuration objects for AWS Client Side Monitoring, including default, environment-based, fallback, and ini file-based configurations. It also includes logic for caching and unwrapping configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate AWS CSM configuration objects from various sources such as environment variables, ini files, or defaults, with support for caching and unwrapping configurations.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that sources configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are not set.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from an ini file, with optional profile and filename parameters.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
